definition: a period of history with its own style
description: An elegant 1920s-style ballroom with a chandelier, a herringbone wooden floor, palms and tall French doors. A young woman in a silver fringed flapper dress dances the Charleston, kicking one leg high, then turns towards the camera, smiles and flings her arms wide. A young man in a black tuxedo and bow tie plays a trumpet, and a young woman in a dark red beaded dress plays the piano. Through the open doors an old-fashioned cream car with spoked wheels is parked.
